facts.raw_span: A 33-year-old female presented with mediastinal mass
no discomfort within 5 days after FNA
high fever and chest pain occurred

respiratory rate 20 breaths/min
body temperature 37.9°C
White cell count 12,110/μL
C-reactive protein 20.85 mg/L, later increased to 261.62 mg/L
Cyst fluid positive for Streptococcus pyogenes
